content: CQRS projection anti-patterns: (1) Synchronous projections in command path — constraint violations roll back business events; fix: always async + eventual consistency. (2) Missing idempotency — at-least-once delivery causes duplicate updates; fix: track last processed event position atomically. (3) Skipping-ahead on error — creates gaps/corruption in read model; fix: halt-on-failure with parking to dead letter, not skip. (4) Normalizing projections — complex JOINs kill query performance; denormalize for reads. (5) Generic CUD events — projections cannot reflect domain semantics. (6) Over-engineering a uniform cross-backend query API — SQL/document/search differ too deeply; keep adapters idiomatic.
